verdict.rationale: Featurebase markets AI that helps "declutter & find the most impactful opportunities" in feedback, and it centralizes insights into a feedback portal with voting on ideas. That loosely implies AI-assisted analysis of feedback, but nothing shows the AI automatically detecting insights or linking them to related feature ideas. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic insight detection within feedback, AI linking of insights to existing feature ideas or posts, details of how the AI works, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
